topic: Topic 01 Round 2: incomplete email reconstruction and robust quotation source-span alignment

open_gaps.description: Structural quotation alignment is partially resolved. The selected evidence does not establish robust direct-email occurrence-to-source-span alignment for markerless, nested HTML/table, edited or paraphrased, short-fragment, and ambiguous-source cases.
open_gaps.suggested_search_query: (email OR "e-mail") AND ("quotation alignment" OR "quote attribution" OR "quoted text matching") AND ("source span" OR "source attribution" OR "occurrence alignment") AND (markerless OR HTML OR nested OR table OR paraphrased OR edited OR ambiguous)
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Future targeted acquisition requires a separate user decision. Seek direct-email evaluation of source identity, span boundaries, and all valid quotation occurrences. E2 is now more decision-relevant. Semantic response and agreement scope belongs to Topic04.

open_gaps.description: The selected corpus does not establish modern 2024–2026 direct-email reconstruction performance, including online or incremental processing, late-parent correction and retraction, or LLM assistance. This is a corpus coverage limit, not evidence of literature absence.
open_gaps.suggested_search_query: (all:email OR all:"e-mail") AND (all:"thread reconstruction" OR all:"conversation reconstruction" OR all:"hidden email" OR all:"reply graph") AND (all:incremental OR all:online OR all:"late parent" OR all:"missing parent" OR all:"out of order" OR all:correction OR all:retraction OR all:LLM OR all:"large language model") AND submittedDate:[202401010000 TO 202609152359]
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Future targeted acquisition requires a separate user decision. Seek annotated direct-email evaluations with explicit reconstruction targets and arrival-order protocols. The query filters submission dates, not verified publication dates. Online prediction alone does not establish correction or retraction performance.

open_gaps.description: Representative joint labels for reply parents, ancestry, Groups, quotation occurrences, source spans, and unique or decision-bearing contributions remain unavailable for msgloom evaluation. Residual complete-original recovery validation belongs here and in E2; A1 primary-paper acquisition is closed.
open_gaps.resolution_notes: In separately authorized work, build an independently annotated and adjudicated mailbox benchmark. Include incomplete histories, multiple parents, ambiguous sources, and representative clients and formats. Report labeled messages, conversations, edges, quote occurrences, and source spans by stratum; report annotation agreement and unresolved-label counts over all annotated units. Keep conversations and quote/template families separate across training, calibration, and test sets. Use known originals withheld from reconstruction input to distinguish recoverable quoted fragments from complete originals. Report exact complete-original recovery over all withheld originals, with observable quoted-content coverage separately. Semantic response-scope annotation remains with Topic04.

open_gaps.description: Preservation of unique and decision-bearing text, recovered-fragment fidelity, and end-to-end quotation occurrence-to-source-span accuracy remain unmeasured.
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Using E1 labels, test conversion, zoning, deduplication, packaging, and display separately across MIME alternatives, markerless quotes, nested HTML/tables, edited quotes, short fragments, and ambiguous sources. Report lost unique spans over all gold unique spans, lost decision-bearing spans over all gold decision-bearing spans, and affected messages over all tested messages. Measure source-link precision over predicted links and recall over all gold occurrence-source links, including multiple valid occurrences. Report exact boundary accuracy and token-overlap precision/recall against gold spans. Compare recovered content with withheld originals; report unsupported generated tokens over all generated tokens and recovered gold tokens over all original tokens. Output-count similarity and retained raw bytes do not establish these results.

open_gaps.description: Late-parent reconciliation, arrival-order sensitivity, correction and retraction, and stable relation or span identity remain untested.
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Replay E1 cases with withheld ancestors, shuffled and repeated arrivals, conflicting identifiers, and later source evidence. Compare intermediate and final states with adjudicated references. Report corrected errors over all errors made correctable by later evidence, stale inferences over all inferences requiring retraction, and unnecessary changes over all previously correct relations. Measure correction latency in arrivals and wall time. Report final-state disagreements across replay orders over all replayed cases, and broken provenance or identity mappings over all tracked spans. Keep quote-source relations separate from reply parents.

open_gaps.description: Confidence calibration and abstention remain unvalidated for reply relations and quotation-source alignment, including true roots, unavailable parents, and ambiguous alternatives.
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Use separate calibration and held-out test sets from E1. Select thresholds only on calibration data. For each relation type, report accepted predictions over all eligible decisions, incorrect accepted predictions over all accepted predictions, and abstentions over all eligible decisions. Report reliability bins with counts, mean confidence, and observed correctness, plus uncertainty intervals. Measure candidate recall over all gold links whose sources are available. Evaluate true-root versus unavailable-parent errors with per-class denominators, and repeat under E3 incomplete-history replay. Keep semantic-response confidence evaluation in Topic04.

open_gaps.description: Exact artifact availability, versions, reproduction details, and code, model, dataset, and annotation reuse rights require verification after candidate selection.
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Conditional on selecting candidate methods or artifacts. Record exact versions or commits, hashes, dependencies, split manifests, label mappings, and scorer conventions. Report artifacts with verified provenance and applicable reuse terms over all selected artifacts, with unresolved items listed separately. Run documented reproduction checks where applicable; report successful checks over attempted checks and metric differences against the stated reference. Missing reporting or failed retrieval does not establish artifact or license absence.

open_gaps.description: Actual Raspberry Pi 5 arm64 latency, memory, incremental processing cost, and persistence cost remain unmeasured.
open_gaps.resolution_notes: Defer until candidate selection and correctness, preservation, and uncertainty validation are established. Benchmark the selected pipeline on the Raspberry Pi 5 with 16 GB RAM and NVMe storage using arm64 artifacts. Report workload message and arrival counts, body sizes, and candidate-set sizes. Measure cold and warm median and p95 latency per message and arrival, messages per second, peak RAM, and storage bytes per processed message. Report failed or truncated messages over all tested messages and preservation failures under resource limits. Historical paper timings do not establish local performance.
